AppImage bundled libraries

This directory retains exact Ubuntu binary-package copyright notices and upstream license texts for the libraries described in inventory.json. The pinned builder extraction scripts are retained as provenance.

libappindicator contains mixed licenses: app-indicator and enum source files allow LGPL version 3 and/or 2.1; compiled generate-id.c and dbus-shared.h specify GPL version 3. Preserve all notices. The GPL-3 text is licenses/libindicator/COPYING; LGPL-3 and LGPL-2.1 texts are under licenses/libappindicator/. Do not describe this binary as unqualified LGPL-only.

The separate AppImage library source artifact contains the exact source DSC, upstream original archives and Debian changes, with hashes. Packaging creates this artifact locally; its creation does not establish public availability. Upstream source URLs identify the retained inputs. DSC signatures have not been verified; SHA256 consistency and exact binary-package matching were verified. No reproducible rebuild or general license compatibility assertion is made.
